_comment: Case-file check after Fig. 8: sort study descriptions by design. Three of each.

stem.en: Sort each study description into the design it belongs to.

text.en: Starts with people who have the disease and people who do not
Looks back from the disease to find past exposure
Asks patients with a rare cancer, and matched patients without it, about their past jobs
Starts with people free of the disease, grouped by exposure
Follows people forward to count who becomes ill
Records which factory workers handle a solvent, then checks their health every year for 15 years

explanation.en: A case-control study starts from the outcome (cases and controls) and asks backwards about exposure. A cohort study starts from exposure in people who do not yet have the outcome and follows them forward in time.

hints.en: For each description, ask what the investigator knows on the first day: who is ill, or who is exposed?
